thread:
Maya R: Draft is up — pasted the current blog draft and quick asks below. Need legal + product eyes before we lock publish schedule. Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/abc123

Alex K: Nice start. Left a couple inline suggestions around benchmark callouts and tone. Can we tighten the performance line items?

Maya R: Good call @Alex K — will reconcile with the metrics doc. Quick question for @Samir P: can you confirm the 95th latency stat used in the public benchmark (p50/p95)?

Samir P: Confirmed — p50: 70ms, p95: 210ms on Dedicated-8 with batching disabled. Added a short note in the metrics sheet: https://ourmetrics/reports/rl-infer-1

Tessa L: From comms POV, prefer we avoid raw ms in top-line marketing — suggest "sub-300ms p95" unless legal wants the exact numbers in the body or a footnote.

Maya R: OK will change the lead stat to "sub-300ms p95" and include the detailed numbers as a footnote linking to the benchmark.

Legal: Quick pass — generally fine. Two asks: (1) remove/replace the phrase "industry-leading" unless you can cite a third-party source, (2) add a short privacy note for demo/recorded data.

Maya R: Will remove "industry-leading" and add the privacy blurb under "Data and privacy". Thanks @Legal.

Alex K: For the webinar/publish CTA routing — propose a single public CTA: "Try Redwood" that goes to the launch form, plus a separate "Request a Dedicated Trial" variant for enterprise prospects. HubSpot mapping below.

ops-bot: HubSpot mapping snippet for launch form:
```
form_id: rwd-launch-cta
utm_source: newsletter
lead_route: prod_web_inbound
persona: developer|platform
priority: standard
```

Samir P: Routing looks good. For leads tagged as 'enterprise' please route to sales-sdr-enterprise@redwood.com and set lead_score >= 70.

Tessa L: I can turn this into three social copy variants and the hero visual by Wed morning. Will sync with design.

Alex K: :thumbsup: from me, small nit on headline tone (made a suggestion inline).

Maya R: Timeline check — aiming to publish Thu 11am PT, webinar the following Tuesday. If there are no blockers by EOD tomorrow I'll lock the publish and start the HubSpot form sync.

Legal: We'll do one final sweep on the edited copy tomorrow AM.

Maya R: Thanks all — locking edits now and will push the final doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/abc123?final
